scenes.caption: They looked back and laughed. / He was way behind.
He tried to catch up. / He tripped and fell.
The next morning, he came back. / He ran. And fell again.
Days passed. / But every morning, he returned.
One day, the two came back. / They started running.
Suddenly, someone passed them. / The same skinny stickman.
Only now, / he didn't even look back.
DISCIPLINE MAKES NO NOISE. / RESULTS DO.
